prospective_issues.finding: Lifecycle uses one state while MarketObject.visit_state/evidence_state/eligibility are free strings without generator-specific compatibility or transition validation. No stable visit identity or typed observation log exists.
prospective_issues.consequence: An append can say state=contacted while payload visit_state remains unvisited; repeat visits cannot be reconciled by independent visit IDs. Existing configured tradable_states correctly allows contact/reclaim to remain usable.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Keep existence/eligibility, visits and evidence as independent typed dimensions with generator-declared transitions; append observation records linked to frozen geometry versions. Preserve compatible legacy records via explicit adapter/version.

prospective_issues.finding: A single append is atomic but split/merge siblings, retired parents and relationships require separate commits; no all-or-none multi-object event cut exists.
prospective_issues.consequence: A freeze or restart between members can expose half a split/merge. Journal head guards for append/freeze already protect single-record races, not multi-record atomicity.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Prevalidate complete typed transition batches then commit one immutable batch envelope with a single cursor and idempotency identity; atomic membership must survive restart and duplicate delivery.

prospective_issues.finding: Relationships have only at, no separate observed/publication clocks; relationship() never calls timestamp(at), is not tied to frozen candidate frontier, and has no head-guarded validation/commit. _state discards all relationships.
prospective_issues.consequence: Historical relation/lineage projections and later-known relation corrections cannot be reconstructed through public queries; caller can backdate a newly appended relation.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Typed relation records with event and known clocks, exact endpoint kinds/versions, definition and supersession; append validation with the same publication/frontier rules and atomic event boundary as versions; historical relation query by cut.

prospective_issues.finding: Nonempty source_event_ids suffice without registered source availability; parents may resolve as either a version hash or free anchor ID. Anchor evidence_version is discarded in _state.
prospective_issues.consequence: Formation provenance can be unverifiable; explicit namespaces, known-time source support and parent/revision types are absent. Unknown eligibility is blocked for tradable states, but arbitrary claimed eligible evidence is trusted.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Register typed external-evidence/anchor references with known time, support and original version; retain full evidence records; validate referential closure and exact endpoint namespaces without requiring all source systems to be implemented.

prospective_issues.finding: Caller-supplied new object ID with reused evidence is accepted as another object. Same-source relation is optional metadata; there is no canonical birth identity or action-alias index.
prospective_issues.consequence: Renaming a failed object can look like a new opportunity; same-price independent anchors and same-evidence aliases are not distinguished by a reusable identity contract.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Separate immutable object birth keys, canonical evidence/idea relations and downstream action alias keys. Distinct generators/anchors remain distinct candidates; exact shared-evidence action deduplication must not merge mere geometric overlap.

prospective_issues.finding: Every query/admission reads and reconstructs the full journal; active-asof scans every version. No indexed projection, checkpoint cursor or bounded hot-state expiry/archive service exists.
prospective_issues.consequence: This is a literal reconstruction baseline, not the parent O(log active set) indexed service. History and cost grow with unrelated objects.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Retain a separate literal oracle and add per-object revision indexes, known-time relation/event indexes and hash-bound checkpoint cursor. Declare actual query cost O(log revisions + returned rows) and honest active-set output-size cost; preserve archival retrieval of expired/failed candidates.

prospective_issues.finding: asof exposes only latest object per ID; no public exact version, complete revisions, visits, relations or candidate-cut retrieval API exists. ObjectTarget accepts any nonempty object_version and caller-supplied band independently.
prospective_issues.consequence: Original label geometry/history is physically in journal but cannot be reconciled through typed registry lookup; expired versions or geometry corrections can be joined incorrectly downstream.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Provide get_version/history/candidate_cut and frozen target-binding adapter that proves geometry/version/cut membership. Keep target horizons and scored original objects fixed after correction or expiry.

prospective_issues.finding: MappingProxy protects mapping contents but self.lifecycles is a replaceable public attribute; asof trusts the replacement without comparing stored registry contract.
prospective_issues.consequence: A caller can change active-set semantics after journal creation without a versioned contract update.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Expose an immutable bound lifecycle configuration, verify it at restore/query boundaries and persist exact configuration identity in projections/checkpoints.

prospective_issues.finding: Lifecycle identity fixes instrument and anchor_start; anchor_end can only extend. Source and parent lists may otherwise change. There is no explicit correction/reanchor/roll relation or source-repair dependency closure.
prospective_issues.consequence: Later geometry correction can be versioned only under geometry_may_change; shortening a corrected anchor or changing raw contract needs a linked identity and policy. Source evidence silently changes without typed revision links.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Define correction versus new/reanchored/mapped birth explicitly, store mapping revision and exact source coordinate, and emit invalidation descendants at current known time. Never backdate revised geometry into historical candidate cuts.

prospective_issues.finding: No production module instantiates ObjectRegistry; F10.OBJECTS is a declarative stage0 preceding-state port. E0 VisitTracker stores visits by E0Object.version, separately from registry.
prospective_issues.consequence: Adding registry machinery alone does not establish runtime or E0 consumer parity; new geometry versions can restart independent E0 visit state unless mapping is explicit.
prospective_issues.bounded_proposal: Register exact additional factual ports/schema and an explicit adapter into the preceding-state publication boundary. Preserve E0 baseline; integration assertions must cover restart midway through a visit and alias/revision policy before claiming consumer parity.
